items.q: I was playing in that club... Lee Larkins was the guy, and he had us all over to his house

ctx.x: I knocked myself out. Lee Larkins was the guy, and he had us all over to his house when -- you know, had something to eat and all like that, and drink, and I can't think of the name of his band, but it'll come to me after a while, because I was playing in that club. Let's rest a minute, will you?

items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was a good man, then. [INTERVIEWEE] Everybody from Steubenville, Ohio, they would say, 'There's Lee Larkins.' You know, he was given quite a hand... and he played real good.

ctx.x: He was a good man, then.
